title: Fix: longest run counter
prompt: The method should return the length of the **longest run of equal adjacent values**. Example failure: `{1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 1}` returns 3 (correct) but `{2, 2, 1, 1}` returns 3 (wrong — should be 2). Find and fix the bug.

tests.name: corrected runs
tests.hint: The counter never RESETS when the run breaks — add the else branch resetting cur to 1.
